notes: Printed: '... search your library and/or graveyard for a Shrine card and put it onto the battlefield.' Sanctum of Tranquil Light is in your graveyard; the opponent's graveyard Shrine (Sanctum of Stone Fangs) is not yours to search. On your next upkeep 'fire' returns your Tranquil Light to the battlefield; the opponent's Shrine stays in its graveyard.
